messages:
Ava: Heads-up: planning a tiny OSS refapp walkthrough + 25-min webinar next month. Goal: show how to run a reproducible local benchmark and ship a 10-min starter. Need copy, bench numbers, landing + lead routing.
Rohit: I can write the how-to and the benchmark methodology. Propose we publish a results table with testbed details (model variant, quant, hw, batch).
Dina: Copy ask: 300-500 word blog, 5-tweet thread, and a short landing blurb to gate the webinar. Keep the messaging dev-first, reproducible, and not hyperbolic.
Kai: I'll prepare a demo repo with a Docker image and a tiny script. Sample run command:
```
# quick local run
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-3b-q4 --seq 512 --batch 2
```
We can attach sample p50/p95 and cost-per-token outputs.
Ava: inbound flow: HubSpot form -> tag refapp-oss-2026 -> assign to dev-sdr pipeline. Dina add UTM params to all links.
Rohit: For bench, use 1000 requests, random prompts, cache warm. We'll report median latency and tokens/sec. Avoid headline multipliers unless we include the baseline.
Dina: Timeline: draft assets by Fri, legal check Tue, rehearsal the week before. Who owns Twitter seeding?
Kai: I'll seed community channels and post on Discussions once blog is live. PRBot: scheduled draft created: OSS Refapp Bench - draft.md (owner: Rohit).
Ava: Nice. Action items: Rohit -> blog + bench table; Dina -> landing + tweets + HubSpot; Kai -> demo repo + docker image; I'll coordinate promo calendar. Reconvene Tue 10am.
